title: ZZZ Female Measurements
rights: Measurements compiled from modelmetrics.net. Character artwork is © HoYoverse and shown as fair use; portraits come from the official HoYoverse site and the ZZZ Fandom wiki.

fields.name: Source roster key from measurements3.3.csv
fields.slug: URL slug used by the per-character pages
fields.aliases: Extra search terms (wiki page, outfit names)
fields.cm: Height as charted, in cm (may include ears, footwear or accessories)
fields.stature_cm: Height shown in the UI and used for comparisons; equals cm unless the chart counts an appendage
fields.diff_cm: Bust minus under-bust, cm (recomputed for 1 dp precision)
fields.uk: UK bra size as supplied by the source
fields.basis: standard, except Jane Doe uses her measured outfit as the canonical record; other outfit variants are exposed under skin
fields.skin: Measured outfit variant with its own numbers
fields.name_ja: Official Japanese name from the HoYoverse character page
fields.name_zh: Official Simplified Chinese name from the HoYoverse character page
fields.desc_zh_cm: Simplified Chinese profile copy, centimetre version
fields.desc_zh_in: Simplified Chinese profile copy, inch version
fields.tags_ja: Japanese display labels for the computed classes
fields.tags_zh: Simplified Chinese display labels for the computed classes
fields.shape: Hourglass / Balanced / Straight from bust, waist and hips
fields.hourglass_score: flare × bust–hip balance; higher is a sharper hourglass
